new-game-text.text: Birth begins; the new-game setup follows world generation.

enter-load-text.text: Load game: drive prompt and ten fixed save slots.

load-world-text.text: Loaded game enters the world map; save parsing is not modelled.

enter-customize-text.text: Customize world: land mass, temperature, climate and age.

customize-world-text.text: Custom parameters enter Birth; selected values are not modelled.

choose-seven-civs-text.text: 7 Civilizations chosen: civ_total = 6, players = 0xFF; tribe question.

choose-six-civs-text.text: 6 Civilizations chosen: civ_total = 5, players = 0x7F; tribe question.

choose-five-civs-text.text: 5 Civilizations chosen: civ_total = 4, players = 0x3F; tribe question.

choose-four-civs-text.text: 4 Civilizations chosen: civ_total = 3, players = 0x1F; tribe question.

choose-three-civs-text.text: 3 Civilizations chosen: civ_total = 2, players = 0x0F; tribe question.

choose-tribe-1-text.text: First tribe row chosen: civnow = 1, civ_tribe_of[1] = 1; leader name.

choose-tribe-9-text.text: Second-group row 9 chosen: civnow = 1, civ_tribe_of[1] = 9; leader name.

intro-begin-text.text: Play begins at the world map.

enter-city-text.text: City screen; city 0 is the declared selector.

build-improvement-text.text: Representative improvement committed as production code -5.

city-buy-text.text: Unit rush purchased: shield_box set to 10*cost and the treasury charged.

city-buy-improvement-text.text: Improvement rushed: shield_box set to 10*cost and the treasury charged.

toggle-auto-build-enabled-text.text: Automatic production enabled: status bit 0x10 set.

toggle-auto-build-disabled-text.text: Automatic production disabled: status bit 0x10 cleared.

open-units-text.text: City unit list opened with cursor 0.

unit-next-text.text: Next unit; cursor clamped to the last garrison slot.

unit-select-text.text: Unit selected; army-record moves and goto reset are not modeled.

close-units-text.text: Unit cursor stored at [0x70DC]; returned to the city.

toggle-city-view-second-text.text: City view; assets and animation are outside this scene.

end-turn-text.text: Turn and year counters advanced; economy, AI and unit resets are outside the model.

new-game-after-end-text.text: Game-over state cleared; returned to the title menu.

contexts.title: Title menu
contexts.description: DOS title menu over the logo; five entries. Civ64 SCENES.md 6; civd GAME.C _game_menu.

contexts.title: Load a saved game
contexts.description: Drive prompt and ten fixed CIVIL0..9.SVE slots. Civ64 SCENES.md 7.2; civd SAVE.C _load_game.

contexts.title: Customize world
contexts.description: CUSTOM.PIC with land-mass, temperature, climate and age questions. Civ64 SCENES.md 7.4; civd GAME.C _game_menu.

contexts.title: Birth - world generation
contexts.description: Eight picture scenes and STORY.TXT events. Civ64 SCENES.md 8; civd WORLDGEN.C _make_world.

contexts.title: Difficulty level
contexts.description: DIFFS.PIC portraits and five levels. Civ64 SCENES.md 9.1; civd NEWGAME.C _new_game.

contexts.title: Level of competition
contexts.description: Civilization count menu. Civ64 SCENES.md 9.2; civd NEWGAME.C _new_game.

contexts.title: Pick your tribe
contexts.description: Tribe records and portraits. Civ64 SCENES.md 9.3; civd NEWGAME.C _new_game.

contexts.title: Your name
contexts.description: White text-entry box. Civ64 SCENES.md 9.4-9.5 and 10.4; civd NAMES.C _rename_leader/_edit_line.

contexts.title: Introduction text
contexts.description: KING.TXT *INIT text with the leader, tribe and starting advances. Civ64 SCENES.md 9.6; civd NEWGAME.C _new_game.

contexts.title: World map - play screen
contexts.description: 15x12 viewport, minimap, status and unit panels. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 1-6; civd MAP.C/TURN.C/CONTROL.C/UNITS.C.

contexts.title: City screen
contexts.description: Info/Happy/Map/View city screen. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.1; civd CITYMGT.C _city_process.

contexts.title: City production chooser
contexts.description: What shall we build? Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.12; civd ECONOMY.C _find_slot.

contexts.title: City unit list
contexts.description: Unit cursor opened by key a. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.1; civd CITYMGT.C.

contexts.title: City view
contexts.description: 19x12 city view; new wonder dissolve and animations. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.2-7.3; civd CITYVIEW.C _city_scene.

contexts.title: Reports and advisors
contexts.description: O14 report frame with F1-F10 pages. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.14; civd ADVISORS.C/REPORTS.C.

contexts.title: Civilopedia
contexts.description: Index and entry lookup. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.13; civd PEDIA.C _civilopedia/_pedia_show.

contexts.title: Diplomacy and audience
contexts.description: Leader audience and government change. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.9-7.10; civd AUDIENCE.C/DIPLOMAC.C.

contexts.title: Spaceship
contexts.description: Spaceship screen and launch surface. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.16; civd SPACESHP.C.

contexts.title: Hall of Fame
contexts.description: FAME.DTA entries. Civ64 SCENES.md 7.5 and SCENES-PLAY.md 7.17; civd FAME.C.

contexts.title: Game over
contexts.description: End checks and ending screens. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.17; civd TURN.C _game_turn/REPLAY.C.

contexts.title: Newspaper
contexts.description: Newspaper page with headline and torn edge. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.7; civd NEWS.C _news_box.

contexts.title: Palace
contexts.description: Palace view and improvement scene. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.8; civd PALACE.C _palace_view.

contexts.title: Leader audience
contexts.description: Throne room/leader screen. Civ64 SCENES-PLAY.md 7.9; civd AUDIENCE.C _load_leader.

objects.label: Start a New Game
objects.description: Starts world generation, then the new-game setup.

objects.label: Load a Saved Game
objects.description: Opens the drive/slot loader.

objects.label: Customize World
objects.description: Opens the four world-parameter questions.

objects.label: View Hall of Fame
objects.description: Reads FAME.DTA and shows six entries.

objects.label: Load first slot
objects.description: Declared slot 0; the save-file parser is outside this scene.

objects.label: Cancel load
objects.description: Returns to the title menu.

objects.label: Land mass
objects.description: World parameter DGROUP:7EF6; the selected item is not modelled.

objects.label: Temperature
objects.description: World parameter DGROUP:7EF8; the selected item is not modelled.

objects.label: Climate
objects.description: World parameter DGROUP:7EFA; the selected item is not modelled.

objects.label: Age
objects.description: World parameter DGROUP:7EFC; the selected item is not modelled.

objects.label: Begin world
objects.description: Enters Birth with the declared parameters.

objects.label: Cancel customize
objects.description: Returns to the title menu; the DOS path has no cancel, so this is an authored navigation aid.

objects.label: World-generation story
objects.description: Picture/text sequence; timing and assets are outside this scene.

objects.label: Continue after Birth
objects.description: Moves to the difficulty question.

objects.label: Chieftain
objects.description: Sets cur_tier = 0 (easiest); civd NEWGAME.C menu row 0.

objects.label: Warlord
objects.description: Sets cur_tier = 1; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 1.

objects.label: Prince
objects.description: Sets cur_tier = 2; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 2.

objects.label: King
objects.description: Sets cur_tier = 3; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 3.

objects.label: Emperor
objects.description: Sets cur_tier = 4 (toughest); civd NEWGAME.C menu row 4.

objects.label: 7 Civilizations
objects.description: Sets civ_total = 6 and players = 0xFF; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 0.

objects.label: 6 Civilizations
objects.description: Sets civ_total = 5 and players = 0x7F; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 1.

objects.label: 5 Civilizations
objects.description: Sets civ_total = 4 and players = 0x3F; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 2.

objects.label: 4 Civilizations
objects.description: Sets civ_total = 3 and players = 0x1F; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 3.

objects.label: 3 Civilizations
objects.description: Sets civ_total = 2 and players = 0x0F; civd NEWGAME.C menu row 4.

objects.label: Tribe menu
objects.description: Tribe choice; representative rows 1 and 9 are bound.

objects.label: First tribe row
objects.description: Sets civnow = 1 and civ_tribe_of[1] = 1 for the representative first row.

objects.label: First second-group row
objects.description: Sets civnow = 1 and civ_tribe_of[1] = 9 for the first alternate-tribe row.

objects.label: Leader name field
objects.description: Thirteen-character edit field; text entry is not executed by this scene.

objects.label: Accept name
objects.description: Advances to the introduction text.

objects.label: Opening text
objects.description: The selected starting advances and tune are outside this scene.

objects.label: Begin play
objects.description: Enters the world map.

objects.label: World map
objects.description: 15 columns x 12 rows of 16x16 squares; terrain/unit/city layers are not rendered.

objects.label: Minimap
objects.description: 80x50 world overview with the view rectangle.

objects.label: Status panel
objects.description: Population, year, research and treasury/rate projection.

objects.label: Unit panel
objects.description: Active-unit name, moves, home city and stack.

objects.label: Menu bar
objects.description: GAME, ORDERS, ADVISORS, WORLD, CIVILOPEDIA drop-downs.

objects.label: Open city
objects.description: Enters the selected city screen.

objects.label: Reports
objects.description: F1-F10 report frame and pages.

objects.label: Civilopedia
objects.description: Index and entry lookup.

objects.label: Diplomacy
objects.description: Leader audience and government change.

objects.label: Spaceship
objects.description: Spaceship screen and launch surface.

objects.label: Newspaper
objects.description: Newspaper page with headline and continuation cue.

objects.label: Palace
objects.description: Palace improvement and view scene.

objects.label: Leader audience
objects.description: Throne-room/leader screen.

objects.label: End turn
objects.description: Advances the declared turn/year counters; economy, AI and unit resets are outside the model.

objects.label: City header
objects.description: City name and population; name catalog is outside the fixture.

objects.label: City resources
objects.description: Food, shields, trade, luxury, tax and science rows.

objects.label: City radius
objects.description: 21-square worked map; tile assets are not rendered.

objects.label: Buildings and wonders
objects.description: Improvement list, MORE paging and wonder precedence.

objects.label: Production box
objects.description: Selected unit/improvement and stored shields.

objects.label: City tabs
objects.description: INFO/HAPPY/MAP/VIEW tabs; detailed tab text is in the city fixture.

objects.label: City units
objects.description: Unit panel/cursor; opens the bounded unit-list context.

objects.label: Change production
objects.description: Opens the production chooser (key c).

objects.label: Buy production
objects.description: Unit rush price is computed from utypes cost and shield_box; commit sets shield_box to 10*cost. CITYMGT.C:1401-1435.

objects.label: Buy improvement
objects.description: Improvement rush price doubles the clamped cost raw; wonders past index 21 double again. CITYMGT.C:1408-1415.

objects.label: Automatic production
objects.description: Toggles townbuf[city].status bit 0x10; civd CITYMGT.C:1380-1381.

objects.label: Rename city
objects.description: Text entry and city-name storage are outside this scene.

objects.label: City view
objects.description: Calls O19:0000(city, -1); opens the full-screen city view.

objects.label: Exit city
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Settlers
objects.description: Commits production code 0; supported by the bounded city fixture and runtime record read.

objects.label: Militia
objects.description: Commits production code 1; supported by the bounded city fixture and runtime record read.

objects.label: Representative improvement
objects.description: Sets production code -5 as a representative improvement index; the source chooser writes -improvement.

objects.label: Unit list
objects.description: Cursor and count are declared state; source clamps choice_f to 0..unit_count_i-1.

objects.label: Next unit
objects.description: Right arrow advances choice_f and clamps it to unit_count_i-1; CITYMGT.C:1500-1515.

objects.label: Previous unit
objects.description: Left arrow backs choice_f up and clamps at 0; CITYMGT.C:1503-1515.

objects.label: Select unit
objects.description: Enter/Space stores the cursor and activates the unit; army-record effects are not modeled. CITYMGT.C:1516-1521.

objects.label: Close unit list
objects.description: Stores the cursor at [0x70DC] and returns to the city.

objects.label: City view scene
objects.description: Assets, palette, seeded grid and animation timing are outside this scene.

objects.label: Exit city view
objects.description: Returns to the city screen.

objects.label: Report frame
objects.description: Title, realm, leader and year header.

objects.label: City status
objects.description: O14:186F; rows and paging are not rendered.

objects.label: World map report
objects.description: O12:0000; 4x4 terrain tiles.

objects.label: Close reports
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Civilopedia index
objects.description: Advances, units and terrain tables.

objects.label: Civilopedia entry
objects.description: BLURB text and picture cells are outside this scene.

objects.label: Close Civilopedia
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Leader audience
objects.description: Throne room/leader picture path; dialogue and attitudes are outside this scene.

objects.label: Government change
objects.description: New Cabinet display; government rules are not modelled.

objects.label: Leave diplomacy
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Spaceship scene
objects.description: Part grid, stats and star field are not rendered.

objects.label: Build spaceship
objects.description: Build/launch rules are outside this scene.

objects.label: Leave spaceship
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Hall entries
objects.description: Six entries from FAME.DTA; file parsing is outside this scene.

objects.label: Close Hall of Fame
objects.description: Returns to the title menu.

objects.label: Game-over ending
objects.description: Trigger conditions are outside this scene; the context is state-reachable for inspection.

objects.label: New game after ending
objects.description: Resets the declared scene state to the title menu.

objects.label: Newspaper page
objects.description: Headline text and torn-edge art are outside this scene.

objects.label: Continue from newspaper
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Palace view
objects.description: Section composition and assets are not rendered.

objects.label: Leave palace
objects.description: Returns to the world map.

objects.label: Audience view
objects.description: Leader portrait, expression and lower text strip; dialogue is outside this scene.

objects.label: Leave audience
objects.description: Returns to the world map.
